name: Odysseus
used_note: Exodus caught up with this upstream dev revision on 2026-10-24 (sync/odysseus-2026-10-24), keeping Exodus's local modifications. This is not an unmodified Odysseus installation.

name: Vaultwarden
used_note: Official Vaultwarden 1.37.4 container, installed 2026-10-19 after a stopped-service backup of data/vaultwarden; OCI labels match this source revision. Compose pins vaultwarden/server:1.37.4 by digest, so restarts never pull a different image. The previous 1.37.3 image is kept locally as vaultwarden/server:rollback-1.37.3.

name: DeepSeek Harness
used_note: Published @deepseek-ai/dsh package pinned to 0.2.1-rc.2 (npm latest on 2026-10-19). Developer preview, with an Exodus model gateway and separate coding workspace. 0.2 refuses wildcard binds, so the supervisor binds the container address. Its new product-analytics plugins only run in the desktop profile and Exodus keeps DSH_TELEMETRY_DISABLED. The 0.1.7-rc.2 image stays local for rollback. Newer prereleases are not installed automatically.

name: SearXNG
used_note: Pinned by tag and digest in docker-compose.yml since the 2026-10-24 Odysseus catch-up (upstream's trust-checked image). A computer that still runs an older SearXNG image gets this one on its next `docker compose pull searxng`. The tracked branch may contain unreleased changes.

name: ChromaDB
used_note: Official chromadb/chroma:1.5.9 image. Its release tag and the cli-1.4.4 tag point at the same source revision, which is why the bundled chroma executable reports 1.4.4 while the image and the Exodus chromadb-client are 1.5.9 (the server version API reports 1.0.0). The image has no source-revision label, so this is a release match, not verified build provenance. Compose pins 1.5.9 by digest since 2026-10-19; it was the same image that latest had already installed.

name: ntfy
used_note: Official ntfy v2.32.0 image, installed 2026-10-19; the executable reports 2.32.0 and a test publish/poll succeeded. Compose pins this tag by digest. The previous 2.27.0 image is kept locally as binwiederhier/ntfy:rollback-2.27.0.
